semantic.justification: V4DQJW adds native FastSaxSerializer/FastSerializerHelper text/byte export, original1MiB cache, ordered token/value emission, XML10 and literal x-escape rules, APPEND/PREPEND/POSTPONE marks and original sorted buckets. XmlFilterBase now owns the native fragment-serializer factory with original no-header/VML/+xml predicate. Actual ZipFragmentStream/ZipStorage, OOXML token names and relationship/content-type owners are reused. Caller-provided actual FastTokenHandler replaces native component-service acquisition; no fake global context or token catalog is introduced. UTF16 host strings use the existing UTF8 byte transport binding; no exact claim is made for invalid UTF16 conversion or malformed UTF8 diagnostics. Physical buffers/refcounts/debug structural stacks are erased under GC; native output preconditions become host errors. File-local native invalidChar is exported only for source-scoped algorithm testing. Native numeric/double overloads and complete DOCX/XLSX export orchestration remain pending. No document/file UI behavior or whole-native parity is claimed; previous statuses and intentional file workflows remain unchanged. Native TokenValue nToken/pValue fields retain a borrowed std::string_view over UTF8 bytes. The byte overload does not copy: input buffer changes before synchronous tag emission remain visible. Host string encoding storage stays alive through immediate emission. No generic attribute tuple or snapshot replaces this native record. Keep native mbMarkStackEmpty and cache mbWriteToOutStream as separate original flags. mark pushes before fallible cache.setOutput and sets the empty flag only after success; an initial output failure may leave a nonempty stack with a true empty flag. mergeTopMarks follows that original flag, and getData runs before popping. WRITER138/CALC-304 record this preserved error-state asymmetry; a genuine closed ZipFragmentStream test pins it. Native private start/single/attribute-write/byte-write/sort method boundaries are retained. Native full FastAttributeList export overload now preserves queued variadic values and the VML raw-prefix XML-escaping bypass. Parser/unknown-attribute and complete format orchestration remain unported.
